title: Expanded CSV and PDF always carry the Sales Type column
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: A work order with different Labor and Parts representatives was invoiced today, and you export the Expanded report with the Sales Type column off.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} exists; it was invoiced today with a labor line and a part; Labor {Sales-rep-A}, Parts {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide, with the Sales Type column off on screen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Export the Expanded CSV.
  2. Open the CSV and find the rows for {Work-order-1}'s invoice.
  3. Export the Expanded PDF and find the same rows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the CSV downloads.
  • Step 2: it has a Sales Type column right after Status, and before Location when the file has a Location column; the Labor row reads "Labor" with blank parts cells; the Parts row reads "Parts" with blank labor, hours and Shop Supplies cells.
  • Step 3: the PDF has the Sales Type column in the same place, right after Status and before any Location column; the cells of the side a row is not credited with show a dash.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R23: “The Expanded CSV and the Expanded PDF always carry the Sales Type column, after Status and before Location, whatever the screen shows. In them, the cells of the side a row is not credited with are blank in the CSV and show a dash in the PDF.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 24: “24. (a) as the feature spec: a dash on screen and in the PDF, an empty cell in the CSV. The 0.0 rule still applies to an invoice with one person on both sides.”
  • Chris Ward's answer 26: “26. (a) Status, Sales Type, Location.”
